lock.authorization: The four-condition Liu evaluation may run only with these exact protocol, implementation, backbone, and eta-artifact hashes.

claim_boundary: This is a one-backbone, one-parameter development sufficiency test. It does not confirm population-level v2, introduce a second memory store, identify a biological residual pathway, change tanh, fit a new readout, or permit Liu-informed adaptation. A valid failure closes the family in which the existing first-order signal can be recovered by a low-capacity response-expression correction; it does not erase the supported fast-weight global mechanism.

registered_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for policy-residual minus original H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and H>A under policy residual is not robustly wrong-sign: its bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
registered_rules.control_specificity: Each paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for policy residual minus matched-magnitude null and policy residual minus shuffled residual retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.fast_weight_necessity: The policy-residual condition passes every qualification_v2 intervention and order-invariance rule.
registered_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Policy-residual remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original v1.
registered_rules.local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for policy-residual minus original retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Policy-residual nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and no more than 0.02 below original v1.
registered_rules.preserve_other_relations: The policy-residual-minus-original mean over the other seven retained relations has a paired-bootstrap lower bound no smaller than -0.01.
registered_rules.query_binding_preservation: Both policy-residual matched-minus-mismatch normalized operator-gain contrasts remain positive and equal original within 1e-7 because this estimand precedes policy correction.
registered_rules.terminal_projection_preservation: The policy-residual expected-rank-minus-MAP participant-bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero.
